edits.value_json: Oracle-bone 火 in 合集 11503 may refer to 火星, without specifying 心宿二 or the planet Mars. Here 火星 is identified as the historical name for 大火/心宿二. The name’s motivation and its link to literal ‘fire’ are not established.
